case_title: Shyam Narain v. The State of NCT of Delhi
mitigating_circumstances: Accused has four children depending on him
trial_court_outcome: Convicted of rape and sentenced to life imprisonment
neutral_facts: The accused was charged with raping an eight-year-old girl. The prosecution presented the testimony of the victim, medical evidence, and the conduct of the accused to establish the crime. The victim initially claimed she had fallen and sustained injuries, but later revealed that the accused had raped her and threatened her. The accused denied the allegations and claimed he took the girl to the hospital for medical treatment. The trial court convicted the accused based on the victim's testimony and medical evidence, sentencing him to life imprisonment. The High Court upheld the conviction and sentence.
